pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Transfiguration — Christ standing in a white oval mandorla on a cracked gold-ochre fresco ground with both arms stretched wide and his pale robe falling straight to his feet, a haloed apostle in dusky rose kneeling below him with one hand on the ground and two more haloed figures standing at the left and right edges, after six days jesus took with him peter, james, and john the brother of james, and led them up a high mountain by themselves, there he was transfigured before them, his face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_the_transfiguration

pictures.scene: Washington Allston, Elijah in the Desert — a great bleached dead tree with a raven perched on its bare trunk and a second raven flying below it, blue mountains and piled clouds standing behind, and the small grey-robed prophet seated alone on the stones at the lower right, suddenly moses and elijah appeared before them, talking with jesus, peter said to jesus, lord, it is good for us to be here, if you wish, i will put up three shelters, one for you, one for moses, and one for elijah
pictures.name: pd_allston_elijah_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Cross in the Mountains — a dark crucifix standing in silhouette on a rocky summit among fir trees, the bare rock lit pink beneath it and shafts of light fanning up through an orange and grey sunset sky, while peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, this is my beloved son, in whom i am well pleased, listen to him, when the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_the_cross_in_the_mountains

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — a fishing boat heeling steeply as a white breaking wave bursts over the bow, one man clinging to the rigging beside the torn sail and the rest of the crew crowded aft in shadow under a black sky, then jesus came over and touched them, get up, he said, do not be afraid, and when they looked up, they saw no one except jesus
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Joos de Momper, Mountain Landscape — a pale ochre cliff with firs growing along its crest and a thin waterfall spilling down its broken face, a wooded gorge opening to the right where two small travellers come down a red earth path under a grey evening sky, as they were coming down the mountain, jesus commanded them, do not tell anyone about this vision until the son of man has been raised from the dead, the disciples asked him, why then do the scribes say that elijah must come first
pictures.name: pd_momper_mountain_landscape

pictures.scene: Giuseppe Angeli, Elijah Taken Up in a Chariot of Fire — the white-bearded prophet borne upward in a brown robe and a great billowing white mantle with the golden wheel of the chariot turning beside him, pale flames streaming out beneath his feet and a dark shore and water lying far below, jesus replied, elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things, but i tell you that elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished, in the same way, the son of man will suffer at their hands
pictures.name: pd_angeli_elijah_taken_up_in_a_chariot_of_fire

pictures.scene: King David Kneeling Before an Altar — the crowned king kneeling in polished armour under a heavy gold embroidered cope worked with small painted scenes, one hand laid flat on his breast and his harp leaning against his knee, an angel in white hovering above him at the left and an open book held out to him at the right, then the disciples understood that he was speaking to them about john the baptist, when they came to the crowd, a man came up to jesus and knelt before him
pictures.name: pd_king_david_kneeling_before_an_altar

pictures.scene: Gabriel Metsu, The Sick Child — a woman in a brown jacket and blue skirt holding a limp child across her lap and looking down at it, the child in a yellow jacket and white shift staring out with its legs hanging slack, a small dark crucifixion picture on the pale wall behind them, lord, have mercy on my son, he said, he has seizures and is suffering terribly, he often falls into the fire or into the water, i brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him
pictures.name: pd_metsu_the_sick_child

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Healing the Blind — a bald old man in a grey blue robe groping forward with both hands held open before him, a close press of bearded heads behind his shoulder and a woman in rose and gold turning away in the foreground, a white classical temple and a far street lying beyond under a clouded sky, o unbelieving and perverse generation, jesus replied, how long must i remain with you, how long must i put up with you, bring the boy here to me, then jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_christ_healing_the_blind

pictures.scene: Jean Francois Millet, The Sower — a labourer in a brown smock and blue trousers striding down a dark ploughed slope with the seed bag gathered at his hip and his arm flung out across his body, a thin band of pale dawn sky and one lit ridge behind him, afterward the disciples came to jesus privately and asked, why couldn't we drive it out, because you have so little faith, he answered, for truly i tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, move from here to there, and it will move, nothing will be impossible for you
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_sower

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Taking of Christ — Christ in a red robe with his hands clasped low and his eyes cast down while Judas grips his shoulder and leans in close to his face, a soldier in black armour reaching across them out of the darkness and a disciple crying out at the left edge, when they gathered together in galilee, jesus told them, the son of man is about to be delivered into the hands of men, they will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised to life, and the disciples were deeply grieved
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_taking_of_christ

pictures.scene: Pieter Brueghel the Younger, The Tax Collector's Office — a crowded village office with bulging document bags hung in rows from the beams and bundles of papers stacked along the shelves, peasants waiting in a press with their hats held in their hands, one carrying a dead goose and a woman at the left setting down a basket of eggs, after they had arrived in capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to peter and asked, does your teacher pay the two drachmas, yes, he answered, when peter entered the house, jesus preempted him, what do you think, simon, he asked, from whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes, from their own sons, or from others
pictures.name: pd_brueghel_tax_collectors_office

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Herring Net — a fisherman in dark oilskins bent over the gunwale of a dory hauling a net heavy with silver herring up out of the green swell, the mast of the schooner leaning behind him under a flat grey sky, from others, peter answered, then the sons are exempt, jesus declared, but so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch, when you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin, take it and give it to them for my tax and yours
pictures.name: pd_homer_the_herring_net

lines.text: After six days Jesus took with Him Peter, James, and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
There He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and His clothes became as white as the light.
Suddenly Moses and Elijah appeared before them, talking with Jesus.
Peter said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters, one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!
When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.
Then Jesus came over and touched them. Get up, He said. Do not be afraid.
And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.
The disciples asked Him, Why then do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?
Jesus replied, Elijah does indeed come, and he will restore all things.
But I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him whatever they wished. In the same way, the Son of Man will suffer at their hands.
Then the disciples understood that He was speaking to them about John the Baptist.
When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Jesus and knelt before Him.
Lord, have mercy on my son, he said. He has seizures and is suffering terribly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
I brought him to Your disciples, but they could not heal him.
O unbelieving and perverse generation! Jesus replied. How long must I remain with you? How long must I put up with you? Bring the boy here to Me.
Then Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.
Afterward the disciples came to Jesus privately and asked, Why couldn't we drive it out?

Because you have so little faith, He answered. For truly I tell you, if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, Move from here to there, and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.
When they gathered together in Galilee, Jesus told them, The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
They will kill Him, and on the third day He will be raised to life. And the disciples were deeply grieved.
After they had arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, Does your Teacher pay the two drachmas?

Yes, he answered. When Peter entered the house, Jesus preempted him. What do you think, Simon? He asked. From whom do the kings of the earth collect customs and taxes: from their own sons, or from others?
From others, Peter answered. Then the sons are exempt, Jesus declared.

But so that we may not offend them, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take the first fish you catch. When you open its mouth, you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for My tax and yours.
